notes.title: Update 2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
It’s been a while! How’s everyone doing?

What’s New :

- Fear Mechanic: Wasn’t working as intended. 

This was the key fix needed to add more challenge.

- Levels: Reworked several areas, removed some sections, 

improved doors, and optimized level loading.

- Fall Damage: Now properly interacts with the fear mechanic.

- Options Menu: Added an FPS counter and more customization options.

- Lighting & Fog: Adjusted lighting for levels with multiple visual issues,

 along with fog improvements.

- Shooting Mechanic: Tweaked for better functionality.
